candidats.description: Looking at the flying express track from the Manhattan-bound platform of the 111th Street IRT Flushing Line station, above Roosevelt Avenue and 111th Street in Corona, Queens. Express tracks like these were frequently found on the former IRT elevated in Manhattan. This one facilitates the two yard tracks from the nearby Corona Yard.

candidats.description: Protesters for a walk- and cycleway across the Auckland Harbour Bridge , between Auckland City , and en:North Shore City in New Zealand , shown north of the bridge's central span, with many on their way back to the south at this stage. The protesters swarmed onto the bridge after several individuals made their way around police barriers and walked / cycled onto the motorway, upon which the whole northbound traffic was stopped by police and highway workers, in turn animating the rest of the crowd to join them on the now-closed lanes (with police deciding to abandon the attempt to turn them back
